package pricing
namespace retained_surface
import 규칙 "example/rules"

entity Integer id "urn:retained:integer"
entity Boolean id "urn:retained:boolean"
activity Imported(규칙.Amount) -> 규칙.Amount id "urn:retained:imported" computes "return 규칙.요금(input)"
activity Delivered(규칙.Amount) -> 규칙.Amount id "urn:retained:delivered" computes "return input"
activity Adjust(Integer) -> Integer id "urn:retained:adjust" computes "return input - 4" assembling {
    choice "direction" operand_order at "0" intent "입력에서 4를 뺀다. Subtract four from the input."
    criteria {
        predicate "positive" activity "Nonnegative"
        input "[9]"
        holdout_input "[13]"
    }
    attempts "2"
}
activity Nonnegative(Integer, Integer) -> Boolean id "urn:retained:nonnegative" computes "return input1 >= 0"
bind Imported.result -> Delivered.input
